# UMG C2PA Validator Service

Local Mac demonstration of C2PA inspection in a music-intake workflow.

- [Source and quick start](https://github.com/jeremybboy/umg-c2pa-validator-service)
- [Architecture](https://github.com/jeremybboy/umg-c2pa-validator-service/blob/main/docs/architecture.md)
- [Agent contract](https://github.com/jeremybboy/umg-c2pa-validator-service/blob/main/AGENTS.md)
- [Security](https://github.com/jeremybboy/umg-c2pa-validator-service/blob/main/SECURITY.md)

AI analysis is simulated; DDEX is illustrative. Test trust is explicitly labelled.
